subject: Deployment mode & HIPAA / SOC2 follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment mode & HIPAA / SOC2 follow-up

Hi James —

Thanks again for taking time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and suggested next steps so we’re aligned on requirements and timeline: 

Summary of needs you shared
- PHI handling for clinical notes and care coordination (HIPAA scope)
- Need for audit logs and 12-month retention for user activity
- SOC 2 Type II evidence required for vendor review; DPO expects to see policies and control mappings
- Procurement will need a executed BAA before production traffic

Recommended deployment options (short):
1) Hosted API (fastest): Redwood-hosted endpoints with encryption in transit & at rest; acceptable for some non-production workloads but requires a BAA and additional contractual controls for PHI production use.
2) Dedicated capacity: Reserved GPU pools in our cloud tenancy with tenant isolation and stronger contractual SLAs — good middle ground for predictable throughput + PHI with a BAA.
3) Private VPC / On-prem: Customer-managed VPC or on-prem install for full network isolation and on-prem KMS — recommended if Elara needs full control of keys or has strict data residency/audit requirements.

Specific asks / next steps I propose:
- I’ll attach our SOC 2 Type II attestation and a deployment-options brief. Please confirm who on your side will review (security, legal, procurement).
- If security wants to run a short questionnaire, Neha can be the primary for answers and evidence exchange.
- Procurement: once you confirm BAA redlines we can turn around a draft within 2 business days.

Target timeline: initial evidence & BAA review this week -> pilot on Dedicated capacity in July -> production after BAA + SOC2 sign-off (tentative mid-August).

If that aligns, I’ll send the attachments and calendar invite for a 30-min checklist review with your security and procurement.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

1) SOC2: can you confirm the period covered by the report and whether there are any open exceptions? We need the full report (not just a bridge letter) for our vendor assessment.
2) Audit logs: can Redwood guarantee immutable audit logs for 12+ months and provide a schema for the logs (what fields are included)?
3) BAA: procurement will review your template; can you send a DocuSign-ready draft?
4) Private VPC: our infra lead asked whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS (HSM / Cloud KMS) in the private VPC deployment.

Security is available for a quick sync tomorrow morning if that helps.

Thanks — I’ve looped in Procurement & Security.

James — great questions. Answering inline below and attaching the BAA draft + a short audit-log schema sample.

1) SOC2: the attached SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2026.pdf covers 01 Jan 2026 – 31 Dec 2026. No open exceptions called out in the opinion. If your team wants, Neha can connect your security lead to our auditors for additional Q&A.

2) Audit logs: Redwood supports immutable audit logging with a 12-month retention default; retention can be configured longer. The audit-log schema (attached) includes: timestamp, actor_id, request_path, resource_id, action, response_code, client_ip, and a hashed-kv for request payload metadata. We can provide a sample export and schema mapping.

3) BAA: attaching a DocuSign-ready BAA template (BAA-template.docx) and a DocuSign link to the draft. We can accept minor redlines but require standard BAAs for PHI.

4) Private VPC / KMS: yes — in Private VPC and in our On‑Prem options we support customer-managed keys (Cloud KMS / HSM). For Dedicated capacity we offer envelope encryption where customer KMS is supported for key wrapping; full HSM-managed keys are best in Private VPC or On‑Prem.

Attachments included:
- SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2026.pdf
- Redwood-Deployment-Options.pdf
- BAA-template.docx
- audit-log-schema.csv (sample)

Proposed immediate steps:
- Neha to be our security point-of-contact for evidence exchange (neha.kapoor@redwood.ai).
- I’ll share a 30-min checklist invite for Thursday to align on evidence list and BAA timeline.
- If Procurement grants a quick sign-off window, we can spin up a Dedicated pilot while BAA is finalized (isolated staging only).

Let me know who should receive the DocuSign invite and preferred timing for Thursday.

Thanks,
Marissa
